provisional_findings.title: Generic/external tool schemas can advertise constraints the local validator does not enforce
Loader registration is publication-atomic, not construction-lifetime atomic
provisional_findings.qualification: conditional on generic/external tool construction owning resources or side effects; core foreground ownership is explicit

provisional_findings.title: Concurrent first-use foreground MCP initialization can silently omit configured tools
Remote MCP annotations can breach the delegated read-only authority boundary
provisional_findings.qualification: requires a configured remote server with false/inaccurate readOnlyHint; final D2/D4 trust model still governs repair

provisional_findings.title: A failed MCP server setup can leave partially registered dead capabilities
Stdio MCP readiness has no deadline and serial startup can block the application indefinitely
Main browser/device file and working-directory authority bypasses workspace confinement
provisional_findings.qualification: non-managed/full-host contexts with browser/device enabled and workspace confinement expected; delegated roles and managed WebUI are narrowed/blocked

provisional_findings.title: desktop_use global input bypasses the main risky-action approval boundary
provisional_findings.qualification: requires tools.desktop_use.enabled=true; disabled by default and managed WebUI withholds the unconfined tool

provisional_findings.title: Generic owned-process cleanup does not prove descendant quiescence
Explicit foreground migration dropped the advertised apply_patch capability
web_fetch output limits do not bound downloaded response bytes
VPN session creation can outlive caller cancellation
provisional_findings.qualification: conditional on the external broker completing a side-effecting request after the client task is cancelled

provisional_findings.title: Process-completion persistence performs synchronous SQLite durability work on async gateway/exec paths
The shipped /goal command advertises sustained-goal behavior that default production composition cannot activate
Gateway cron polling performs synchronous full-history durable filesystem work on the event loop
Append-only scheduler evidence has a finite hard lifetime in the live timer path
provisional_findings.qualification: Later A01 management/migration review found no scheduler-history rollover/archive owner; earlier provisional qualification resolved.

provisional_findings.title: Completed delivery dispatch entries are retained for the lifetime of the outbox store
Model-facing cron list/remove authority is global across chats
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on multiple mutually untrusted chats/users sharing one agent/service; single-owner instances may intentionally define one administration domain.

provisional_findings.title: Shipped local-trigger commands queue work that the default gateway never consumes
Local-trigger restart recovery can replay an already committed turn and its effects
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on local-trigger execution being activated; default foreground gateway does not start the runner.

provisional_findings.title: Local-trigger automation can affirm a pending risky-action approval
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on local-trigger execution being activated; approval admission is source-blind once automation shares the bound session/channel alias.

handoffs.note: K01 coordinator PASS at F56/P0/R0 with thirteen promoted findings and eight final questions. Seven conditional findings and T01/A01 cross-stream deduplication are preserved; integrated review, repairs and Git checkpoint remain pending.

provisional_findings.title: Prompt/skill loading has confinement gaps outside centralized resource-policy validation
provisional_findings.qualification: Initially established for non-managed restricted bootstrap/skill reads; K01-E also found Dream/evaluator workspace prompt overrides read symlinked paths directly without ResourceAccessPolicy even in managed mode. Each trigger still requires a crafted/local prompt or skill path.

provisional_findings.title: save_knowledge does not enforce the active project's knowledge_repos association
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on project association being intended as an ownership boundary and multiple writable knowledge repos being visible.

provisional_findings.title: Runtime skill discovery does not enforce the shipped skill validation contract before shadowing/activation
provisional_findings.qualification: Shipped built-ins themselves demonstrate validator/runtime drift; reliability/configuration-integrity finding rather than arbitrary code execution.

provisional_findings.title: The cron skill misdocuments reminder execution and default timezone semantics
provisional_findings.qualification: Timezone statement happens to match only when timezone_mode=auto; reminder output still follows a fresh agent turn.

provisional_findings.title: The ClawHub skill installs and manages skills in the default workspace instead of the effective agent workspace
provisional_findings.qualification: Works when the configured workspace is the default ~/.nanobot/workspace; non-default workspaces are affected.

provisional_findings.title: The tmux skill recommends launching Codex with its approvals and sandbox disabled
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on using the coding-agent section without an already-proven external sandbox; pinned Codex defines --yolo as dangerously bypassing approvals and sandbox.

provisional_findings.title: Mobile testing skills require both platform toolchains even though each supports either platform
provisional_findings.qualification: Hosts with npx plus only one valid platform toolchain are affected; hosts with both Xcode/xcrun and adb installed are not.

provisional_findings.title: video-understanding silently bypasses Nanobot provider routing for semantic frame analysis
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on OPENAI_API_KEY and the OpenAI SDK being available with semantic mode enabled; no external semantic request occurs on the fallback/no-semantic path.

provisional_findings.title: webapp-testing recommends a caller-supplied CDP mode that the live browser wrapper always blocks
provisional_findings.qualification: Only the caller-supplied --cdp recommendation is proven broken; configured shared attachment and other browser paths remain separate.

provisional_findings.title: Non-positive video max-gap values can spin forever before frame capping
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an explicit zero/negative --max-gap-seconds override; the shipped default 6.0 path is unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Live prompt guidance advertises retired search/edit tools absent from the default registry
provisional_findings.qualification: Default production composition is affected; customized plugin deployments may supply compatible names. apply_patch overlaps T01-F10 and must be deduplicated in integrated review.

provisional_findings.title: Degraded compaction can elevate raw transcript/tool text into the future system prompt
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a raw-fallback compaction condition plus instruction-like user/tool content in the archived chunk; tool policy still constrains side effects.

provisional_findings.title: Dream can persist skill instructions outside its own audit and restore boundary
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a manual Dream run or enabled periodic Dream producing a skill edit; external VCS may independently record files but Dream log/restore does not.

handoffs.note: E02 F68/P0/R0 report/coverage published and coordinator-checked PASS with twenty-three promoted findings and nine retained questions; integrated review remains pending.

provisional_findings.title: Failed SDK transcript ingestion can leave a partial live-session mutation
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on unmanaged persistent ingest (default save=True) plus metadata or a valid message prefix before a later validation failure; managed persistent ingest is rejected before mutation and save=False is detached.

provisional_findings.title: Non-loopback WebSocket configurations can admit unauthenticated agent clients
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a network-reachable listener whose effective client authentication is disabled or publicly self-serviceable. Defaults are loopback plus token-required; static-token and properly protected token/trusted-proxy deployments are excluded.

provisional_findings.title: Windows media GC can delete generated assets that are still referenced
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on Windows-style absolute paths plus execution of the media GC path. Default orphan grace is seven days; quota eviction can act earlier when enabled. POSIX reference discovery is unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Global generated-assets library silently omits sessions after the first 200
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on more than 200 persisted WebUI sessions. Per-session asset routes are unaffected; the global endpoint truncates session discovery before group pagination and exposes no continuation.

provisional_findings.title: Lossy WebUI transcript filenames collapse distinct valid chat IDs
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on caller-supplied/imported/legacy chat IDs that differ only through characters collapsed by safe_key(), especially colon versus underscore. UUID-created chats do not naturally trigger it.

provisional_findings.title: Session deletion can report success while readable WebUI transcript residue remains
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a filesystem deletion failure. Normal deletion removes both canonical and transcript state; transcript-only history is intentionally still listable/readable when canonical state is absent.

provisional_findings.title: Transcript rotation can duplicate completed turns after a mid-rotation write failure
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a multi-turn transcript above the rotation threshold and a write/replace/manifest failure after segment commit but before active-tail replacement.

provisional_findings.title: Session search can return transcript-only results that read_session rejects
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a WebUI transcript without canonical session metadata and a content query that matches it. Canonical and ordinary cross-channel persisted sessions are unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Failed Temporary Chat attachment deletion is forgotten instead of retried
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an unlink/filesystem failure during Temporary Chat cleanup. Normal disposal removes tracked media.

provisional_findings.title: Discarded Temporary Chat tombstones grow without bound until gateway shutdown
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a large number of Temporary Chats during one long-lived gateway process. Restart clears the tombstones; ordinary low-volume use has small impact.

provisional_findings.title: CLI-app WebUI state is not scoped to the gateway's explicit config path
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on multiple explicit gateway/config instances in one process or embedding with a config path different from the process-global path. Common single-instance CLI startup normally aligns the paths.

provisional_findings.title: Successful WebUI build commands can leave a stale/missing bundle without failing startup
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on the frontend command returning zero while failing to refresh the expected bundle. The shipped Vite path normally writes the expected dist and ordinary write failures should usually return nonzero.

provisional_findings.title: MCP WebUI credential/runtime state is not scoped to the gateway's explicit config path
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an explicit gateway/config path differing from the process-global config path. Normal single-instance CLI startup generally aligns those paths; OAuth store locking/generations and managed-path exact-match cleanup do not fix cross-instance root selection.

provisional_findings.title: Cancelled skills.sh installs can outlive their WebUI owner
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on cancellation after npx launch or timeout with surviving descendants. Normal successful installs are awaited; the SkillHub path does not create this child process, and remote installs remain separately package-policy gated.

provisional_findings.title: WebUI folder-grant authority is not scoped to the gateway's explicit config path
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an explicit/multi-instance gateway whose config path differs from the process-global path. Normal single-instance CLI startup generally aligns those paths; conflicting live writers may fail closed, but stale/shared grants and private-root selection can cross instance authority.

provisional_findings.title: Provider OAuth credential authority is shared across explicit gateway configs
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on explicit gateway config paths being independent instance/security boundaries. Single-instance CLI use is not claimed broken; current Codex/Copilot compatibility intentionally uses user-home auth paths and xAI uses the process-global data root.

provisional_findings.title: Remote-access owner authority defaults to the process-global instance root
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on divergent explicit/global config paths with default remote-access state/socket paths. Explicit distinct state_dir/socket_path avoids the collision.

provisional_findings.title: Settings usage accounting is not scoped to the explicit gateway config
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on multiple logical instances sharing the process-global data root. If usage is intentionally user-global, this becomes a product-contract/documentation question.

provisional_findings.title: Truthy non-boolean remote-access disable values enable remote access
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a non-boolean payload such as the string "false". The shipped UI is expected to send a JSON boolean and the enable route is local-browser-only.

provisional_findings.title: Post-effect mutation failures are replayed as completed failures and suppress shared-state invalidation
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a failure after the underlying mutation has committed. Pre-effect validation failures remain correctly cached as failures; timeout/cancellation are already uncertain.

provisional_findings.title: Remote-access pairing renewal is implemented and called by the WebUI but omitted from settings routing
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic for the local WebUI renewal helper. The remote owner operation registry does not expose renewal, so this is a local product-route defect rather than missing owner permission.

provisional_findings.title: Desktop notification GET has a tokenless cross-origin loopback side-effect surface
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a browser/request form that sends the cross-origin loopback GET despite private-network/mixed-content protections. The fixed argv command prevents shell injection.

provisional_findings.title: Legacy unpaginated WebUI thread reads bypass the response projection budget
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on using the no-query compatibility path with a large transcript. The paginated client path is bounded; remote post-build size checks do not prevent full projection allocation.

handoffs.note: E01-F Feishu control/setup/instance/UI completed at F40/P0/R55 with twenty-six provisional findings total and zero publication credit; next is E01-G Feishu runtime.py and websocket.py only.

provisional_findings.title: Failed outbound delivery can poison origin duplicate suppression
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a source-bound fingerprint being inserted before an actual send failure and a later same-origin outbound carrying the same normalized content. Separate source IDs and the explicit receipt-capable cron path are excluded.

provisional_findings.title: Shared channel runtime/validation/transcription can ignore the gateway's explicit config path
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an explicit gateway/manager config path differing from the process-global path. Feishu E01-F adds a concrete QR-flow consequence: the path-scoped settings handler owns the request, but its connector persists registration credentials through the process-global Feishu helper before separately enabling the gateway-scoped target.

provisional_findings.title: Truthy non-boolean enabled values activate packaged channels
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on malformed/manual packaged-channel config using a non-boolean truthy enabled value. Feishu's own multi-instance adapter independently applies bool(config['enabled']), so truthy strings also activate Feishu instances. Normal settings writers are expected to persist booleans.

provisional_findings.title: Telegram enablement can persist a startup-invalid config and escape as SystemExit
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on enabling Telegram with an empty/missing effective allowFrom. WebUI feature enable is local-browser restricted; correctly configured allow lists are unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Inline-keyboard callbacks in Telegram forum topics lose topic session identity
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on Telegram forum/topic use with inline keyboards enabled. Private and non-topic chat-wide sessions are unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Telegram ordinary delivery hides retries beneath the manager attempt cap
provisional_findings.qualification: Ordinary best-effort Telegram delivery only; the qualified cron receipt path performs no hidden provider retries. Duplicate effects require an ambiguous timeout whose provider-side send completed.

provisional_findings.title: DingTalk inbound filenames can escape the media root and overwrite arbitrary writable paths
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on DingTalk preserving sender-controlled absolute/parent-traversal filename syntax. If the provider canonicalizes safe basenames, the path-escape consequence does not activate.

provisional_findings.title: Denied DingTalk senders can trigger unbounded inbound file download work before authorization
provisional_findings.qualification: Practical amplification depends on DingTalk attachment/rate limits. The download URL is provider-issued; this finding does not claim directly attacker-chosen SSRF.

provisional_findings.title: Persistent DingTalk stream failures are reported as running
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on persistent/non-transient stream/setup failure. Temporary network loss may intentionally be represented by a live reconnecting supervisor.

provisional_findings.title: DingTalk retries replay already-delivered text/media after later part failure
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a multipart ordinary send and a retryable failure after at least one earlier part completed; single-part sends do not have this intra-message replay window.

provisional_findings.title: DingTalk downloads inbound attachments but bypasses the canonical media/attachment pipeline
provisional_findings.qualification: A sufficiently privileged agent may manually read the textual path; the defect is bypass of canonical adoption/multimodal projection, not guaranteed byte loss in every deployment.

provisional_findings.title: Unauthorized Discord DMs can persist attachments before pairing authorization
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an unauthorized DM carrying attachments. Each file is checked against the adapter's declared 20 MiB cap; guild messages rejected before download are unaffected.

provisional_findings.title: Discord streaming silently loses deltas while the client is unready
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a streaming-enabled turn while Discord client readiness is false. Non-streaming ordinary sends raise and are manager-retried.

provisional_findings.title: Discord attachment upload failures can be hidden as successful message delivery
provisional_findings.qualification: Transport/provider file-send failures are hidden when text or another attachment succeeds. Media-only messages where all attachments fail receive a visible fallback.

provisional_findings.title: Discord multipart retries can duplicate already-delivered files or text chunks
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on multipart ordinary or overflow-stream delivery and a retryable failure after an earlier part completed. Single-part sends are excluded.

provisional_findings.title: Discord startup failures are swallowed before manager failure accounting
provisional_findings.qualification: Primarily startup failures not covered by the REST token probe, stale credentials after validation, proxy/client construction, or other gateway-start exceptions. Partial client cleanup itself is preserved.

provisional_findings.title: Email anti-spoofing accepts SPF/DKIM pass results that are not bound to the allowed From identity
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on the upstream mailbox delivering mail whose visible From is allowlisted while the trusted/pass identities are unrelated, or preserving an untrusted Authentication-Results header. Strong upstream DMARC/authserv-id enforcement can prevent the trigger.

provisional_findings.title: Email acknowledges mailbox messages before durable agent processing
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on failure after UID processing/Seen or queue admission but before durable turn processing. markSeen=false/no post-action preserves the source but changes replay semantics.

provisional_findings.title: Email replies can attach to the wrong Message-ID when one sender has multiple in-flight emails
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on multiple source messages from the same sender before the earlier response is sent. Recipient identity remains the same; source-bound subject metadata is preserved.

provisional_findings.title: Persistent IMAP failures are reported as a running Email channel
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on persistent/non-healing IMAP login/TLS/protocol/poll failure. Temporary reconnecting failures may intentionally retain a live supervisor.

provisional_findings.title: A cancelled Email runtime does not own its in-flight IMAP worker
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on disable/replacement/shutdown during an active asyncio.to_thread IMAP poll. The old worker can continue mailbox/file side effects under stale config after coroutine cancellation.

provisional_findings.title: Email body and attachment limits do not bound full-message fetch or decode memory
provisional_findings.qualification: Practical maximum depends on upstream provider message-size limits. Oversized attachments are skipped after decode; configured limits are not pre-materialization resource bounds.

provisional_findings.title: Email can be enabled with no sender allow-list but cannot bootstrap pairing from inbound mail
provisional_findings.qualification: Explicit allowFrom, wildcard, or pre-existing pairing approval makes the channel usable. This is a setup/admission mismatch, not an authorization bypass.

provisional_findings.title: Same-name Email attachments overwrite one another within a message
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on two accepted MIME parts in one message resolving to the same sanitized filename. Direct path traversal remains prevented.

provisional_findings.title: Feishu validation reports Connection verified without verifying Feishu credentials
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional user-visible consequence on stale/mistyped/nonfunctional manual credentials. The default QR authorization path has stronger provider evidence; runtime startup remains a separate authority.

provisional_findings.title: Feishu QR session storage is mutated concurrently without one session-map lock
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on overlapping local authenticated connect actions. Routes are local-browser restricted; the consequence is settings/connect failure or stale state, not unauthenticated remote memory corruption.

provisional_findings.title: Pairing can durably commit a device before credential custody is established
Mobile WebSocket commands bypass granted chat/media scopes
Refresh rotation can strand a paired device on ambiguous delivery
Versioned mobile route contract contradicts the production edge
Isolated mobile data server exercises materially different authorization and recovery semantics
Systemd supervision reports applied success without checking command success
Pairing can proceed without a verified Tailscale Serve mapping

Mobile HTTP completions can arrive before request correlation is armed
